name: Shelton Farms, Inc.
description: In Whittier, NC, Shelton Farms, Inc. raises Strawberries and Tomatoes on a independent farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring and summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
